name: @jeswr/app-extension
description: Browser extension (MV3) for Solid authentication — injects window.solid (DPoP-authenticated fetch) and a pinned avatar account menu, consistent with the @jeswr Solid app suite.
author: Jesse Wright

scripts.lint: biome check src test e2e scripts
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write src test e2e scripts
scripts.build:dev: pnpm run generate:client-id && webpack --config webpack.config.cjs --mode development --watch
scripts.gate: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run build
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
